benefit.en: The government was criticized for their plans to change certain benefits for old people.
benefit.zh: 政府因改变老年人某些福利的计划而受到批评。

benefit.en: Study abroad students who have greater interaction with local people tend to benefit more.
benefit.zh: 与当地人有更多互动的留学生往往受益更多。

benefit.en: Most of the overseas departments can benefit from being in the EU, for example.
benefit.zh: 例如，大多数海外省都可以从加入欧盟中受益。

benefit.en: Despite these benefits, testing, and English testing in particular, has plenty of critics.
benefit.zh: 尽管有这些好处，测试，尤其是英语测试，也招来了大量的批评。

benefit.en: We’ll look at the benefits, at the risks, and at the ethical questions surrounding surveillance.
benefit.zh: 我们将探讨监控带来的好处、风险以及围绕监控的伦理问题。

behave.en: In Britain, this is a no-no – a way of behaving that is not socially acceptable.
behave.zh: 在英国，这是一个 no-no——一种在社交上不被接受的行为方式。

behave.en: And he knew poor people who sometimes behaved like the starving men in Minnesota.
behave.zh: 他认识一些穷人，他们的行为有时就像明尼苏达那些挨饿的人一样。

behave.en: The idiom cross the line means to start behaving in an unacceptable way.
behave.zh: 习语“越过底线”（cross the line）意味着开始以不可接受的方式行事。

behave.en: It is October 1788. At Windsor Castle, the King of Great Britain is behaving strangely.
behave.zh: 那是 1788 年 10 月。在大不列颠的温莎城堡里，大不列颠国王的行为举止有些反常。

behave.en: In Britain, this is a no-no – a way of behaving that is not socially acceptable.
behave.zh: 在英国，这是一个 no-no——一种在社交上不被接受的行为方式。

bean.en: Luckily, Sharon discovered the winning formula – something her daughter could safely eat – rice and beans.
bean.zh: 幸运的是，莎朗发现了致胜法宝——她女儿可以安全食用的东西——米饭和豆子。

bean.en: Farmers cultivated crops like maize (which is corn), beans, squash, and chili peppers.
bean.zh: 农民种植了诸如玉米（也就是玉米）、豆类、南瓜和辣椒等农作物。

bean.en: Around how many tonnes of cocoa beans were imported to Europe in 2023?
bean.zh: 2023年大约有多少吨可可豆进口到欧洲？

bean.en: And he asked another chocolate lover about whether he looks at where the cocoa beans come from.
bean.zh: 他还询问了另一位巧克力爱好者，问他是否会关注可可豆的来源。

bean.en: In the eastern forests, some farmed crops like corn or beans and squash, and they also hunted and traded.
bean.zh: 在东部森林里，一些人种植玉米、豆类或南瓜等农作物，他们也进行狩猎和贸易。

beginning.en: Things repeat. In cyclical time cultures, time doesn’t really have a beginning or end.
beginning.zh: 它只是在某种程度上不断地周而复始。

beginning.en: Because I knew from the beginning. Literally, I write about this in the book.
beginning.zh: 因为我从一开始就知道。字面上，我在书里写到了这一点。

beginning.en: At the beginning of the pandemic, many people believed the disruption would be short term.
beginning.zh: 在大流行初期，许多人认为这种混乱将是短暂的。

beginning.en: The move was completed in the beginning of the 17th century, around the year 1611.
beginning.zh: 这次迁都于 17 世纪初完成，大约在 1611 年左右。

beginning.en: Like I mentioned at the beginning of this episode, France’s longest border is with Brazil.
beginning.zh: 正如我在本集开头提到的，法国最长的陆地边界是与巴西接壤的。

beetle.en: He spent hours looking for plants and animals and was far more interested in beetles than in theology.
beetle.zh: 他花了好几个小时寻找动植物，对甲虫的兴趣远远超过了神学。

beetle.en: I'm Georgie. And I'm Beth. Georgie, what do apples, carrots and celery have in common with insects like beetles, crickets and grasshoppers?
beetle.zh: 我是乔治。我是贝丝。乔治，苹果、胡萝卜和西红柿有什么共同点，跟甲虫、蟋蟀和蚂蚱这些昆虫一样？

beetle.en: There's something very satisfying about the crunch when you bite into a fresh apple, a stick of celery, or even a roasted beetle!
beetle.zh: 当你咬下一口新鲜的苹果、一根西红柿，甚至是一只烤甲虫时，那种嘎吱作响的声音会带来非常满足的感觉！

benign.en: Tumours can be benign, meaning not cancerous, or malignant, meaning cancerous, and in 2022 there were an estimated 9.7 million deaths from malignant cancers worldwide.
benign.zh: 肿瘤可以是良性的，也就是非癌性的，也可以是恶性的，也就是癌性的。据估计，2022年全球有970万人死于恶性肿瘤。

bend.en: But he's this deeply original writer, and the committee decided to bend the rules for him.
bend.zh: 但他是一位极具独创性的作家，委员会决定为他破例。

bend.en: And I think they're going to bend the curve on healthcare costs.
bend.zh: 我认为它们将改变医疗成本的曲线。

bend.en: That may not sound much, but remember this is the earth itself actually flexing or bending without breaking.
bend.zh: 这听起来可能不算什么，但请记住，这是地球本身在没有破裂的情况下实际弯曲或屈曲。

bend.en: It is a tradition with a core set of characters, bent and rewritten in every generation that has performed it.
bend.zh: 这是一个核心角色固定、但在每一个表演它的世代中都被扭曲和重写的传统。

bend.en: And what you can't do is bend the knee to their hate and fit back into the conformity because it's comfortable and it's warm.
bend.zh: 你不能做的是向他们的仇恨屈膝，回到那种从众中去，因为那样很舒服，很温暖。

behalf.en: Given his influence, he managed to persuade the Pope to do this on his behalf.
behalf.zh: 鉴于他的影响力，他成功说服教皇代为行事。

behalf.en: These “freelancers” are what we might today call “mercenaries”, professional soldiers who fight on behalf of whoever will pay.
behalf.zh: 这些“自由枪骑兵”（freelancers）就是我们今天可能称之为“雇佣兵”（mercenaries）的人，他们是为出价最高者而战的职业军人。

behalf.en: These condottieri were leaders of mercenary bands, hired through a formal contract to fight on behalf of a city-state.
behalf.zh: 这些 condottieri 是雇佣兵团的首领，通过正式合同受雇为某个城邦作战。

behalf.en: On the economy, he positions himself as someone who speaks on behalf of ordinary working people against what he sees as a self-serving elite class of politicians, journalists, and business leaders.
behalf.zh: 在经济上，他把自己定位为普通劳动人民的代言人，对抗他眼中自私自利的政客、记者和商界领袖等精英阶层。

behalf.en: Now, this isn’t due to the great benevolence and kindness of Scandinavian employers, but rather that most jobs are covered by trade union agreements, so the union will negotiate wages on behalf of employees.
behalf.zh: 这并不是因为斯堪的纳维亚雇主多么仁慈和善良，而是因为大多数工作都受工会协议保护，所以工会会代表员工协商工资。

beforehand.en: That wasn’t the only embarrassment. A group of mischievous Labour supporters had found out about the announcement beforehand, and had congregated outside the gates to Downing Street.
beforehand.zh: 这还不是唯一的尴尬。一群调皮的工党支持者事先得知了这一消息，并聚集在唐宁街的大门外。

beforehand.en: A year beforehand, Donald Trump had announced his candidacy for the presidency, and he had been winning support in precisely the kind of communities Vance wrote about.
beforehand.zh: 前一年，唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）宣布竞选总统，并且一直在 Vace 所写的这类社区中赢得支持。

beforehand.en: And all of the reading I had to do beforehand and all of the listening i had to do beforehand as well and i didn't stress myself about what i had to remember so if you listen to this three and a bit hour podcast and you go they talked they said a lot of words there alex said a lot of words chris said a lot of words what's the one thing that you couldn't stop thinking about and there may be nothing fair play we failed if there's one thing that you can't stop thinking about that story about the kid from cumbria that time when Alex had to drive across the country.
beforehand.zh: 还有我之前必须做的所有阅读和听力，我并没有因为必须记住什么而给自己压力。所以如果你听了这三个多小时的播客，觉得他们说了好多话，Alex说了好多，Chris说了好多，那么有什么是你无法停止思考的呢？可能什么都没有，那也公平。如果我们失败了，但如果有一件事是你无法停止思考的，比如那个坎布里亚孩子的故事，或者Alex开车横穿全国的那次经历。

beforehand.en: And all of the reading I had to do beforehand and all of the listening i had to do beforehand as well and i didn't stress myself about what i had to remember so if you listen to this three and a bit hour podcast and you go they talked they said a lot of words there alex said a lot of words chris said a lot of words what's the one thing that you couldn't stop thinking about and there may be nothing fair play we failed if there's one thing that you can't stop thinking about that story about the kid from cumbria that time when Alex had to drive across the country.
beforehand.zh: 还有我之前必须做的所有阅读和听力，我并没有因为必须记住什么而给自己压力。所以如果你听了这三个多小时的播客，觉得他们说了好多话，Alex说了好多，Chris说了好多，那么有什么是你无法停止思考的呢？可能什么都没有，那也公平。如果我们失败了，但如果有一件事是你无法停止思考的，比如那个坎布里亚孩子的故事，或者Alex开车横穿全国的那次经历。

beggar.en: Argos notices the beggar walking past, drops his ears, lifts his head and wags his tail.
beggar.zh: 阿耳戈斯注意到乞丐从旁走过，它垂下耳朵，抬起头，摇了摇尾巴。

beggar.en: There was Sarah Good, a beggar who smoked a pipe and muttered under her breath when anyone refused her charity.
beggar.zh: 其中有萨拉·古德（Sarah Good），一个抽着烟斗的乞丐，当别人拒绝她的施舍时，她会在嘴里嘟嘟囔囔。

beggar.en: So, he returns not in the clothes of a triumphant king, but disguised as a poor beggar clad in rags.
beggar.zh: 因此，他回来时没有穿着凯旋国王的衣服，而是伪装成一个衣衫褴褛的穷乞丐。

bench.en: And if you’ve seen clips of people standing up in an old-looking room with wooden benches with green fabric, shouting at each other, this is what’s happening.
bench.zh: 如果你看过人们站在一个铺着绿色织物木质长椅、看起来很有年代感的房间里互相大喊大叫的片段，这就是正在发生的事情。

bench.en: Adaptation is also intelligence. Adaptation is survival. adaptation is kind of how you're here you're here because you're an adapter and your ancestors were adapters so to adapt you'll see things clearly and if you're seeing them through your own identity it's going to cloud your judgment moving on to sort of thinking about happiness obviously a topic of yours that's a it's honestly the one that i feel least qualified to talk about is it like a guy that's got long arms teaching you how to bench press or a dude that's really tall teaching you how to deadlift someone that feels like they came from behind the eight ball Yeah, you're asking a crazy person about their thoughts.
bench.zh: 适应也是一种智力。适应就是生存。适应是你之所以在这里的原因，你在这里是因为你是一个适应者，你的祖先是适应者。所以要适应，你就要清楚地看到事物，如果你通过自己的身份来看待它们，它会模糊你的判断。继续谈谈关于幸福的思考，显然这是你的一个话题，老实说，这是我感觉最没资格谈论的话题。就像一个长手臂的人教你如何卧推，或者一个很高的人教你如何硬拉，一个感觉像是从劣势中走出来的人。是的，你在问一个疯子关于他们的想法。

bearing.en: Eventually, cornered in what is now modern-day Turkey, and with Roman forces bearing down on him, Hannibal took poison rather than be captured.
bearing.zh: 最终，在今天的土耳其境内被逼入绝境、罗马军队步步紧逼之际，Hannibal服毒自尽，拒绝被俘。

beware.en: Beware the devil; he has evil and cunning ways, and he is sending witches to test you.
beware.zh: 警惕魔鬼；他诡计多端、阴险狡诈，正派遣女巫来考验你们。

betray.en: It shows the reaction of Jesus’s disciples when he tells them that one of them will betray him.
betray.zh: 它展示了当耶稣告诉门徒他们中有人会背叛他时，门徒们的反应。

betray.en: They were betraying Britain because they were British subjects, right?
betray.zh: 他们在背叛英国，因为他们本来就是英国臣民，对吧？

betray.en: He betrayed Milan’s rulers, used his mercenary army to seize control of the city, and declared himself Duke of Milan.
betray.zh: 他背叛了米兰的统治者，利用他的雇佣兵军队夺取了该城的控制权，并宣布自己为米兰公爵。

betray.en: The only way to become more successful than most people is to be willing to do something most people aren't willing to do. and this is that lean in mentality again it's like look it sucks it's shitty you're tired everybody says that you're leaving your friends behind leaving your family behind betraying your culture betraying whatever expectation it is that they have on you you need to do something that most people aren't willing to do because as we've said the average american is obese in debt and divorced like is that really oh brilliant fantastic i'm in the fucking center of the bell curve distribution here.
betray.zh: 成为比大多数人更成功的人的唯一方法是愿意做大多数人不愿意做的事情。这又是那种“倾斜”心态，就像：看，这很烂，这很糟糕，你很累，每个人都说你抛弃了朋友，抛弃了家人，背叛了你的文化，背叛了他们对你的任何期望，你需要做一些大多数人不愿意做的事情，因为正如我们所说，普通美国人肥胖、负债、离婚，这真的……哦，太棒了，太棒了，我正处于钟形曲线分布的中心。

behavior.en: This same behavior, “being late “, can have completely different meanings depending on the culture.
behavior.zh: 同样的“迟到”行为，根据文化的不同，可能会有完全截然相反的含义。

behavior.en: Human behavior and emotions and decision making don’t change as quickly as technology does.
behavior.zh: 人类的行为、情绪和决策并不像技术那样变化得那么快。

behavior.en: When cameras are visible on buildings or on lamp posts, they can discourage criminal behavior.
behavior.zh: 当摄像头显眼地安装在建筑物上或电线杆上时，它们可以起到威慑犯罪行为的作用。

behavior.en: So confidence is often visible through your behavior rather than your language ability.
behavior.zh: 所以，与其说自信体现在语言能力上，倒不如说它往往是通过你的行为表现出来的。

behavior.en: How do we know this isn't some bleeding heart theory to excuse irresponsible behavior?
behavior.zh: 我们怎么知道这不是某种为不负责任行为开脱的滥情理论呢？

beam.en: And then I went home one day and my mom was beaming.
beam.zh: 有一天我回家，我妈妈满面春风。

beam.en: First a board here, and then a beam there.
beam.zh: 先是这里的一块板，然后是那里的根梁。

beam.en: Stress is when, like if you look at an iron beam, when an iron beam is under stress, it's because it's being bent in two different directions at the same time.
beam.zh: 压力是……就像你看一根铁梁，当铁梁处于压力下时，是因为它同时被向两个不同的方向弯曲。
